theme: A clear day with the girls before Disney weekend
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — an open stretch with the girls in the Orlando run before Disney this weekend. The two travel bookings still hanging are about the only things really asking for you.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: Orlando and Disney land Saturday and Sunday for all six of you, and tickets for six still aren't bought. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations, and whether Magic Kingdom has a Halloween party night that weekend, since that changes which park.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out — book it refundable now and fix the dates later. Flagged to book this week; it's now ten days past due.

flagged.title: The IMC intro call is taking shape
flagged.detail: Chie Mitsui looped in Fincity's Misaki-san and drafted starter questions for the first conversation; the question is aimed at Mike, so nothing is blocked on you yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — WSJ, two St. Pete locals, the Press Herald, Italian word-of-the-day, and a couple of travel-review nudges.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: You're moderating a panel at ICGN Toronto
resolved.detail: You said yes to Elizabeth Thomas on Sep 23; she confirmed and said speaker logistics and a pre-conference panel call are on the way.
